t2.title: Children today spending too much time indoors
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Are children today spending too much time indoors?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Modern children spend more time indoors than any previous generation. I believe this trend is genuinely harmful to their development.

Firstly, outdoor play is essential for physical health. Without regular activity, children face rising rates of childhood obesity, weak muscles, and poor coordination. Indoor sedentary habits contribute to long-term health problems.

Secondly, nature exposure benefits mental wellbeing. Studies show children who play outside have lower anxiety, better attention spans, and improved creativity. Screens cannot replicate these benefits.

However, indoor time isn't entirely negative. Safety concerns, extreme weather, and urban environments sometimes make outdoor play difficult. Additionally, educational technology offers valuable learning opportunities.

Nevertheless, balance is crucial. Parents should limit screen time and encourage outdoor activities. Schools should prioritize physical education and outdoor breaks.

Furthermore, communities should create safe outdoor spaces – parks, playgrounds, and nature areas – where children can explore.

In conclusion, getting children outside more is essential for raising healthy, happy, and well-developed individuals.

I go park. It is fun. Kids play. Sun is good. Home is TV. Park is better. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,

I think kids stay home too much. They watch TV and play games. It is not good. I like to play outside because it is fun. I can run and jump. My friends also like the park. But my brother likes TV. He says it is good but I think outside is better because you can get exercise. Maybe kids need to go outside more. It is healthy.

t2.sampleB1:
Are kids spending too much time inside these days? I think so. In my opinion, children need to play outside more often.

Firstly, it's important for their health. If they stay inside all day, they don't get enough exercise. This can lead to problems like being overweight. Also, playing outside helps them build strong muscles.

Secondly, being outside is good for their minds. They can explore nature and learn new things. For example, they can see different types of plants and animals. However, I understand that sometimes it's not safe to play outside, or the weather is bad.

Overall, I believe that parents should encourage their children to spend more time outdoors. It's better for their health and their minds.
t2.sampleB2: Glued to Screens: Are We Raising an Indoor Generation? Take a look around any home today and you'll probably spot a child staring at a screen rather than playing outside. In my view, children really are spending far too much time indoors, and it's something we should take seriously. The main reason is technology. Smartphones, tablets and games consoles are simply more tempting than a trip to the park, so many children happily stay put on the sofa for hours. On top of that, busy parents often feel their kids are safer at home than out and about. Unfortunately, this comes at a cost. Without regular exercise, children are more likely to put on weight and feel restless. Fresh air and outdoor play, by contrast, boost both their mood and their imagination. That said, the answer isn't to ban screens altogether. Instead, parents could set sensible limits and make time for family walks or trips to the countryside. All in all, a little balance goes a long way. If we encourage children outdoors now, they will grow up healthier and happier.
t2.uzSample:
Zamonaviy bolalar avvalgi avlodlarga qaraganda ko'proq vaqtni uyda o'tkazmoqda. Menimcha, bu tendensiya ularning rivojlanishiga chinakam zarar yetkazadi.

Birinchidan, ochiq havoda o'ynash jismoniy salomatlik uchun juda muhim. Muntazam faoliyat bo'lmagan holda, bolalar orasida bolalik semirishi, mushaklarning zaifligi va koordinatsiyaning yomonlashuvi kabi holatlar ko'paymoqda. Uyda harakatsiz o'tirish uzoq muddatli sog'liq muammolariga olib keladi.

Ikkinchidan, tabiat bilan aloqa ruhiy farovonlik uchun foydali. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, tashqarida o'ynaydigan bolalarda xavotirlik darajasi pastroq, diqqatni jamlash qobiliyati yaxshiroq va ijodkorlik darajasi yuqori bo'ladi. Ekranlar bu afzalliklarni takrorlay olmaydi.

Biroq, uyda o'tkazilgan vaqt butunlay salbiy emas. Xavfsizlik masalalari, ekstremal ob-havo va shahar muhiti ba'zan ochiq havoda o'ynashni qiyinlashtiradi. Bundan tashqari, ta'lim texnologiyalari qimmatli o'rganish imkoniyatlarini taklif etadi.

Shunga qaramay, muvozanat juda muhim. Ota-onalar ekran vaqtini cheklashi va ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlarni rag'batlantirishi kerak. Maktablar jismoniy tarbiya va ochiq havoda tanaffuslarga ustuvor ahamiyat berishi kerak.

Bundan tashqari, jamiyatlar bolalar o'rganishi mumkin bo'lgan xavfsiz ochiq maydonlar – parklar, o'yin maydonchalari va tabiat hududlarini yaratishi kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bolalarni ko'proq tashqariga olib chiqish sog'lom, baxtli va yaxshi rivojlangan shaxslarni tarbiyalash uchun zarurdir.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men parkga boraman. Bu qiziqarli. Bolalar o'ynaydi. Quyosh yaxshi. Uyda televizor. Park yaxshiroq. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,

Menimcha, bolalar uyda juda ko'p vaqt qolishadi. Ular televizor ko'rishadi va o'yinlar o'ynashadi. Bu yaxshi emas. Men tashqarida o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki bu qiziqarli. Men yugurishim va sakrashim mumkin. Mening do'stlarimga ham park yoqadi. Lekin akam televizorni yaxshi ko'radi. Uning aytishicha, bu yaxshi, lekin menimcha tashqari yaxshiroq, chunki siz mashq qilishingiz mumkin. Ehtimol, bolalar ko'proq tashqariga chiqishlari kerak. Bu sog'lom.

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Bolalar hozirgi kunda juda ko'p vaqtni uyda o'tkazyaptimi? Menimcha, shunday. Mening fikrimcha, bolalar ko'proq tashqarida o'ynashlari kerak.

Birinchidan, bu ularning sog'lig'i uchun muhim. Agar ular kun bo'yi uyda qolsalar, yetarli jismoniy mashq qilmaydilar. Bu ortiqcha vazn kabi muammolarga olib kelishi mumkin. Shuningdek, tashqarida o'ynash ularga kuchli mushaklar qurishga yordam beradi.

Ikkinchidan, tashqarida bo'lish ularning aql-idroki uchun foydali. Ular tabiatni o'rganishlari va yangi narsalarni o'rganishlari mumkin. Masalan, ular turli xil o'simliklar va hayvonlarni ko'rishlari mumkin. Biroq, men tushunaman, ba'zida tashqarida o'ynash xavfsiz emas yoki ob-havo yomon.

Umuman olganda, men ota-onalar o'z farzandlarini ko'proq vaqtni tashqarida o'tkazishga undashlari kerak deb hisoblayman. Bu ularning sog'lig'i va aql-idroki uchun yaxshiroqdir.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Bolalar bugungi kunda juda ko'p vaqtni uyda o'tkazayaptimi degan savol, bugungi jamiyatda dolzarbdir. Texnologiya inkor etib bo'lmaydigan foydalarni taklif qilsa-da, menimcha, hozirgi nomutanosiblik uy ichidagi mashg'ulotlarga qarab bolalarning rivojlanishiga zarar yetkazadi.

Asosiy jihatlardan biri jismoniy salomatlikdir. O'troq turmush tarzi, ko'pincha ekran oldida ortiqcha vaqt o'tkazish bilan tavsiflanadi, bolalar orasida semizlik darajasining oshishiga va tegishli sog'liq muammolariga olib keladi. Boshqa tomondan, ochiq havoda o'ynash jismoniy faollikni oshiradi, kuchni oshiradi va muvofiqlashtirishni yaxshilaydi.

Bundan tashqari, tabiat bilan aloqa qilish ruhiy farovonlikka katta ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, ochiq havoda vaqt o'tkazadigan bolalarda stress darajasi pastroq, diqqatni jamlash qobiliyati yaxshiroq va ijodkorlik kuchaygan. Video o'yinlarning simulyatsiya qilingan muhiti bu afzalliklarni oddiygina takrorlay olmaydi.

Tan olish kerakki, xavfsizlik masalalari va yashil hududlarga kirishning cheklanganligi kabi omillar ochiq havoda o'ynashni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin. Biroq, ota-onalar va o'qituvchilar ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlarni rag'batlantirish uchun faol imkoniyatlar izlashlari kerak. Sog'lom va har tomonlama rivojlangan avlodni tarbiyalash uchun parklar, o'yin maydonchalari va qulay tabiiy muhitlarga sarmoya kiritish juda muhimdir.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is looking for a fun place to take their children during the holidays. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I know you're looking for holiday activities for the kids. We just visited ThrillZone adventure park and it was amazing! Zip lines, climbing walls, obstacle courses – the children loved it! Perfectly safe too. You should definitely take your family there! Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi!

I go park. Good. Kids like. You go!

Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Akmal,

I went to a park with my kids. It was fun! They have many things to do. It is safe, and the people are nice. You can go there with your kids. It is good for holidays!

See you!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Akmal,

I wanted to tell you about a place we visited recently, called ThrillZone adventure park. It was really good! My children had a lot of fun. They have zip lines and climbing, and I think your kids would enjoy it too. The staff were helpful, and it seemed very safe. You should consider going there during the holidays.

Hope to see you soon,

Dilnoza Umarova

We took ours to ThrillZone adventure park last week and honestly, they had a blast! There are zip lines, climbing walls and loads of activities to keep them busy. It's totally safe too, so no need to worry. You should definitely give it a go! Speak soon, Bekzod Aliyev

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the adventure park. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear ThrillZone Team, Thank you for asking about my experience at your adventure park. I was thoroughly impressed with the visit. The safety standards were excellent, and staff ensured everyone wore proper equipment. My children had an absolutely thrilling time on the activities. The natural setting made it even more enjoyable. However, I have some suggestions. The food options were rather limited and expensive. Additionally, queue times for popular attractions were quite long during peak hours. I would appreciate picnic areas where families can bring their own food. Night adventure sessions would be exciting. Also, a fast-pass option would help reduce waiting times. Overall, ThrillZone provided unforgettable family memories. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Umarova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi ThrillZone!


It was fun! The park is good. My kids like it. Staff is nice. More swings please. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Dear ThrillZone,


Thank you for the park. It was good. My family liked the zipline and the climbing wall. The staff was helpful, and they explained everything. But the food was expensive, and we waited a long time for the rides. Maybe you can have more food and less waiting. Thank you!


Bye,
Dilnoza Umarova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear ThrillZone Team,


Thank you for the email. My family and I visited your adventure park last week, and we had a good time. I think the activities were exciting, especially the rope course. The staff were also very helpful and explained the safety rules clearly.


However, I have a few suggestions. The prices for the food and drinks were quite high. Also, there weren't enough places to sit down and relax. It would be good to have more benches or picnic tables. In my opinion, these changes would make the park even better.


Sincerely,
Dilnoza Umarova
t12.sampleB2: Dear ThrillZone Team, I am writing in response to your email regarding our recent visit to ThrillZone Adventure Park. Overall, my family and I had a wonderful day out. I was particularly impressed by your safety standards, as every visitor was fitted with the correct equipment before taking part. The staff were friendly and professional throughout, which put my mind at rest while the children tackled the more challenging activities. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. Firstly, the food options were rather limited and quite pricey, so more affordable choices would be welcome. Secondly, the queues for popular attractions grew very long during peak hours, and a fast-pass system would help enormously. Despite these minor points, we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and will certainly be back. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli ThrillZone jamoasi,

Sizning sarguzasht parkingizdagi tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Men tashrifdan juda ta'sirlandim. Xavfsizlik standartlari a'lo darajada edi va xodimlar har bir kishi to'g'ri jihoz kiyganiga ishonch hosil qilishdi. Mening bolalarim mashg'ulotlarda juda hayajonli vaqt o'tkazishdi. Tabiiy muhit uni yanada yoqimli qildi.

Biroq, menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Oziq-ovqat tanlash imkoniyatlari juda cheklangan va qimmat edi. Bundan tashqari, mashhur attraksionlarga navbat kutish vaqtlari eng yuqori soatlarda ancha uzoq edi.

Oilalar o'zlari bilan ovqat olib kelishlari mumkin bo'lgan piknik joylari bo'lishini xohlardim. Tungi sarguzasht seanslari juda hayajonli bo'lardi. Shuningdek, tez o'tish imkoniyati kutish vaqtlarini qisqartirishga yordam beradi.

Umuman olganda, ThrillZone unutilmas oilaviy xotiralar taqdim etdi.

Hurmat bilan, Dilnoza Umarova

Salom, ThrillZone!

t12.uzSampleA2:

Park uchun rahmat. Yaxshi edi. Mening oilamga zipline va toqqa chiqish devori yoqdi. Xodimlar yordam berishdi va hamma narsani tushuntirishdi. Lekin ovqat qimmat edi va biz attraksionlarni uzoq kutdik. Balki siz ko'proq ovqat va kamroq kutishni tashkil qila olasiz. Rahmat!


Xayr,
Dilnoza Umarova

Hurmatli ThrillZone jamoasi,


Elektron pochta uchun rahmat. O'tgan hafta oilam bilan sarguzasht bog'ingizga tashrif buyurdik va yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdik. O'ylashimcha, mashg'ulotlar, ayniqsa arqonli yo'lak juda hayajonli edi. Xodimlar ham juda yordam berishdi va xavfsizlik qoidalarini aniq tushuntirishdi.


Biroq, menda bir nechta takliflar bor. Oziq-ovqat va ichimliklar narxlari juda qimmat edi. Shuningdek, o'tirish va dam olish uchun joylar yetarli emas edi. Ko'proq o'rindiqlar yoki piknik stollari bo'lishi yaxshi bo'lardi. Mening fikrimcha, bu o'zgarishlar bog'ni yanada yaxshiroq qiladi.


Hurmat bilan,
Dilnoza Umarova
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli ThrillZone jamoasi,


ThrillZone sarguzasht parkiga yaqinda tashrifimiz bo'yicha sizning keyingi elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, biz ijobiy tajribaga ega bo'ldik va mavjud bo'lgan turli xil tadbirlarni qadrladik. Biz xavfsizlik protokollari yaxshi amalga oshirilganini va xodimlar doimiy ravishda e'tiborli va professional ekanligini his qildik, bu bizning xotirjamligimizga katta hissa qo'shdi.


Shunga qaramay, tashrif buyuruvchilar tajribasini yaxshilash mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, park bo'ylab yo'l-yo'riq ko'rsatkichlari aniqroq bo'lishi mumkin, chunki biz vaqti-vaqti bilan muayyan diqqatga sazovor joylarga qanday borishni bilmay qoldik. Ikkinchidan, xavfsizlik qoidalariga rioya qilish zarurligini tushunsak ham, tashqaridan ovqat va ichimliklar olib kelishga qo'yilgan cheklovlar biroz cheklangan bo'lib tuyuldi, ayniqsa yosh bolali yoki muayyan parhez talablari bo'lgan oilalar uchun.


Ehtimol, park ichida yanada xilma-xil va arzonroq ovqatlanish imkoniyatlarini taklif qilish yoki cheklovlarni biroz yumshatish bu muammoni hal qilishi mumkin. Yaxshilangan yo'l topish ham foydali bo'ladi.


Fikrlarimni ko'rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur. Kelajakda ThrillZonega yana tashrif buyurishni intiqlik bilan kutamiz.


Hurmat bilan,
Dilnoza Umarova
